## NexCare review checklist

- [ ] Branch named `<type>/<issue-number>-<slug>`
- [ ] One issue → one PR (no scope creep)
- [ ] No edits to `COMPLIANCE.md`, `PRIVACY.md`, `SECURITY.md`, or `LICENSE` (or, if there were, DPO/legal reviewed)
- [ ] No "educational only / not for clinical use / synthetic data only" wording introduced
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or hardcoded URLs in the diff
- [ ] No new dependencies added without justification in this PR
- [ ] `.env` not modified or committed
- [ ] Lint and tests pass locally (and in CI)
- [ ] Lighthouse / accessibility checks pass (Phase 1) or unit + integration tests pass (Phase 2+)
- [ ] Diff fully read by Kibet, every hunk understood
